response.summary: Revision 4 resolves both round-3 findings, and I found no new material defects in the specification. PROGRESS-2 is resolved. The plan now gives every local-draft component an edition-scoped device key: SourceWorksheetDrill, AndOrPractice, StagedReasoningDrill, IndicatorWordDeck, DrillEntry and the folded-set aliases. The new edition never falls back to old device keys. Projected 'Completed earlier' work is a separate read-only view, and no writer component mounts until the student explicitly resumes, even with run=1. Tests are required for no writes on projection, writes only to scoped keys after resume, and old device bytes left unchanged. BASELINE-1 is resolved. Old editions are frozen to an explicit ordered 16-step manifest taken from a named main SHA. That list matches the Chapter 1 entries at openingCoursePath.ts:15-30. Chapter 2's seven steps appear only in full-conditionals-v3, the draft's denominator test becomes edition-specific, and the builder must re-fetch main and stop if its course membership has changed. With Chapter 2 limited to v3, compatibility projection only ever applies to Chapter 1 records that shipped. The earlier ACCESS, SEMANTIC, DRILL, REFRESHER, NAV, EDITION, PROGRESS-1 and SELFSTUDY resolutions are unchanged and do not conflict with the new sections. Approval covers the specification only. It is not evidence about implementation, tests or release.
coverage: Re-read the full revision 4 plan text and checked the new 'Device-cache isolation and read-only prior work' and 'Exact legacy baseline' sections against PROGRESS-2 and BASELINE-1.
Compared the 16-step frozen manifest in the plan with OPENING_COURSE_PATH Chapter 1 entries at src/bootcamps/conditionals/openingCoursePath.ts:15-30: same IDs in the same order.

Using code read in earlier rounds, confirmed that the device-key consumers the plan names match the localStorage readers and writers found by grep in src/bootcamps/conditionals: SourceWorksheetDrill:50/71/180, AndOrPractice:59/179/201, StagedReasoningDrill:117/171, IndicatorWordDeck:13/31, and courseProgress useDeviceCourseProgress:34-43.
Confirmed that the mount-time record effect (AndOrPractice.tsx:199-202) is covered by the requirement that writers stay unmounted until explicit resume.

Checked internal consistency across the access table (Chapter 2 limited to v3), the registry, the edition-propagation obligations, the progress storage contract and the numbering rules from earlier revisions.
limitations: This is a specification review only. Nothing was implemented, and no tests, typecheck or build were run; none are claimed to pass.

I did not independently fetch origin/main or query Lovable. The claims that main is 6a167c85 with 16 Chapter 1 steps and is published are the planner's, and the plan itself says the served public bundle is unverified.

useDeviceCourseProgress (courseProgress.tsx:33-34, key `conditional-course-progress:${scope}`) is not named in the device-cache list. Passing the plan's edition-scoped storageScope through OpeningCourseScreen covers it, but the builder's required symbol-search trace should confirm that.

I did not re-inspect the backend metadata schema, teacher producer components or source-content files in this round. Those obligations were accepted in earlier rounds and remain to be checked during implementation.
